Thought: I need to determine which hazard statements (H-phrases) indicate environmental hazards. H-phrases are standardized statements used in the classification and labeling of chemicals to indicate specific hazards.

Let me analyze each option:

A. H290 - This refers to "May be corrosive to metals" which is a physical hazard, not an environmental hazard.

B. H300 - This refers to "Fatal if swallowed" which is a health hazard, not an environmental hazard.

C. H400 - This refers to "Very toxic to aquatic life" which is clearly an environmental hazard as it relates to effects on aquatic ecosystems.

D. H420 - This refers to "Harms public health and the environment by destroying ozone in the upper atmosphere" which is also an environmental hazard as it relates to damage to the ozone layer.

So the correct answers are C and D, as both H400 and H420 indicate environmental hazards.
